    23	- **Function:** `ProductsTab`

    26	The filter intentionally auto-includes hidden/inactive products when `hasPaidPlan(whopProductId)` is true:
    27	- `if (p.isVisible && p.isActive) return true;`
    28	- `if (hasPaidPlan(p.whopProductId)) return true;`

    38	Commit message explicitly states: "auto-show hidden products with paid plans".
    39	
    40	## Proposed Fix
    41	
    42	### Changes Required
    43	1. Remove/guard `hasPaidPlan` auto-include from `products` filter so hidden/inactive entries respect `showHiddenProducts`.
    44	2. If pricing visibility is needed without showing hidden products, keep plan data available for visible products only, or add a separate explicit toggle (`Show hidden paid products`).
    45	3. Update UI copy to avoid ambiguity between hidden-from-store vs hidden-from-AI.
    46	
    47	### Risks
    48	- If auto-show was relied on for tier mapping workflows, removing it may hide useful admin entries unless a separate toggle is added.
    49

    52	- Unit/UI test: hidden + paid product appears when `showHiddenProducts=true`.
